testing_choice.reason: The shell classifier and lifecycle hooks have fast public seams that reproduce the false denials, stale memory output, and recovery failures before each fix.

principles.name: principle-fix-root-causes
principles.decision: Fix the shell classifier, broken engage CLI, stale OptMem call, and missing Codex session archive at their owning boundaries.

principles.name: principle-laziness-protocol
principles.decision: Extend the existing parser with the smallest safe read forms and no new enforcement layer.

principles.name: principle-model-the-domain
principles.decision: Represent a safe read pipeline as parsed command segments whose verbs are all read-only.

principles.name: principle-type-system-discipline
principles.decision: Keep source pins and method packet state in explicit typed records, and parse untyped hook payloads at their boundaries.

principles.name: principle-boundary-discipline
principles.decision: Classify raw shell text once at the hook boundary and keep method policy unchanged.

principles.name: principle-encode-lessons-in-structure
principles.decision: Lock false denials, nearby bypass attempts, compaction re-engagement, and Codex transcript retention into regression tests and live canaries.

principles.name: principle-sequence-verifiable-units
principles.decision: Land the failing regression before the classifier fix, then verify each installed client copy.

principles.name: principle-prove-it-works
principles.decision: Run the original commands through the installed hook and rerun denial canaries after the fix.

principles.name: principle-exhaust-the-design-space
principles.decision: Compare two parser and recovery designs before changing the hook boundary.

principles.name: principle-minimize-reader-load
principles.decision: Keep shell syntax parsing, command safety policy, and route enforcement in their existing single owners.

principles.name: principle-subtract-before-you-add
principles.decision: Remove stale pipelines, obsolete OptMem compression output, and the canary-only stdin engage branch before adding recovery coverage.

principles.name: principle-foundational-thinking
principles.decision: Define safe command segments, route readiness, and transcript retention states before writing control flow.

principles.name: principle-redesign-from-first-principles
principles.decision: Treat direct recovery and Codex conversation retention as lifecycle invariants instead of adding test-only exceptions.

principles.name: principle-make-operations-idempotent
principles.decision: Make repeated engagement, compaction, canary setup, and transcript archiving converge without stale fixtures or duplicate state.

principles.name: principle-separate-before-serializing-shared-state
principles.decision: Give each canary run an isolated method scope and keep shared hook state behind the existing lock.

principles.name: principle-guard-the-context-window
principles.decision: Delegate independent architecture candidates and retain only their scored synthesis in the main thread.

principles.name: principle-build-the-lever
principles.decision: Make the canary runner and clean-export verifier reproduce the hook and distribution guarantees in one command.

principles.name: principle-migrate-callers-then-delete-legacy-apis
principles.decision: Move every engage caller to the direct CLI and delete the synthetic stdin branch in the same change.

principles.name: principle-outcome-oriented-execution
principles.decision: Converge hook callers and lifecycle paths at explicit Codex, Claude, and export checkpoints, then require full verification before delivery.
